q1: SELECT C.DEPT_NAME, SUM(C.CREDITS) FROM COURSE AS C INNER JOIN DEPARTMENT AS D ON (C.DEPT_NAME = D.DEPT_NAME) GROUP BY C.DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(C.CREDITS) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT C.CREDITS) > 5

This means that Q1 will return departments where the number of distinct credit values in courses is greater than 5, and Q2 will return departments where the number of distinct credit values in courses is greater than 8.
